lucy-sales: Quick ask from Prospect: 4-day POC to replace their legacy streaming endpoint with our SDK. Must return validated JSON per request, include one fraud tool call, and show zero visible failures during cutover. Minimize customer code changes.
marco-se: We usually deliver a 1-file shim that maps their current API surface to our streaming client. Two safe patterns: (A) fan-out (mirror to old + new) with dedupe by request-id/response-hash; (B) proxy cutover with warm caches then switch route. Fan-out gives parity metrics.
priya-ml: To avoid regressions ask for their JSON schema + 20 gold examples. We'll run pytest that asserts exact schema conformance. Also pre-warm KV caches by replaying ~500 representative requests or synthetic prompts.
marco-se: Backpressure note: long-lived SSE/WS connections need client-side reconnect + jitter. Recommend SDK over raw HTTP for built-in reconnect and on_function_call hooks.
dylan-devex: Security and creds: provide ephemeral scoped keys (TTL=3600s) and HMAC for webhook callbacks. Example rotation snippet (hosted demo):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral
{ "scope":"poc:generate","ttl":3600 }
# rotate hourly via cron, revoke on failure
```
Quick raw cURL example for streaming + function call (non-SDK):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -d '{"stream":true,"model":"redwood-small","functions":[{"name":"fraud_check","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}}}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Use SDK in prod/demo for robust callbacks.
priya-ml: Token/latency back-of-envelope: if avg request ~70 tokens and peak 60 rps -> ~4.2M tokens/min; factor ~1.15 for function-call overhead. Send 50 sample requests and we'll run token sims.
infra-bot: POC ticket created: POC-31221. Demo cluster spin target: 2025-05-16T09:00:00Z.
lucy-sales: Action items: Marco -> shim + fan-out dedupe doc; Priya -> pytest harness + token sims; Dylan -> ephemeral rotation script + HMAC example; I'll lock schedule with customer for week of May 19. If anyone hits blocker I'll @channel. :thumbsup:
